changes: Cannons can stand pointing up (place one looking down) or hang pointing down (place one looking up), and fire straight along the barrel.
Placed blocks now fall when nothing connects them to the ground: cut a pillar and what's above falls as one piece.
A cannon no longer breaks apart when the block under it goes: it stays up while anything holds it and falls whole when nothing does.
Air drag halved: falls and long slides reach higher top speeds.
